create_SAE_model: create a sparse autoencoder model with configurable input and hidden layer sizes
run_SAE_training: run the SAE training loop on representation data with wandb logging and validation
compute_sae_loss: compute the SAE loss combining MSE reconstruction error with L1 regularization
test_SAE_model: test the trained SAE model on held-out test representations and log results
save_SAE_model: save the trained SAE model to a PyTorch checkpoint file for later use
